ev_0006.summary: Figure (288x446 px image, y down) shows a vertical solid segment A-E at x=233 with A at (233,51) and E at (233,393). Solid segments E-D, A-D and D-C form a triangle-like figure with D at (56.4,216.7). A dashed segment runs from about (123,122) through M (121.9,120.5), a verified right-angle vertex at (139,139), and C (234,240.6), ending near (238,246). Right-angle mark right_angle_01 at (139,139) is verified by local ink; its perpendicular arm has no matching detected segment. The circle (center (162.9,218.4), r 76.7) is a candidate: its visible arcs are partial and C lies about 2.4 px inside it. Vertex coordinates should be flipped for TikZ with y_tikz = 446 - y_px. Label E is ambiguous (E ncc 0.847 vs F 0.836); the bound letter is kept as candidate.
